message: The other day, I realized it had been ages since I checked our smoke alarms. I climbed up on a kitchen chair, feeling like a kid again, and gave each one a little test. To my surprise, they all worked perfectly, and I ended up cracking jokes with my family about my "firefighter" skills. It turned into a cozy evening of chatting about our escape plans and favorite fire safety hacks, complete with popcorn and laughter. It’s funny how a little preparedness can turn into a bonding moment. When was the last time you had a fun family chat about safety?
